entities.definition: Confirmation period for continuous economic grid import during an already authorised EV-before-export top-up. Brief spikes can retain, but never increase or start, its existing current. All electrical, source, reserve and ownership gates remain immediate.
entities.producer: EvBeforeExportImportNumber.native_value projects RuntimeConfiguration.ev_numbers; setup and the number edit one persisted setting.
entities.unit_and_sign: Whole seconds, 0 through 300 inclusive, default 60. Zero restores immediate import withdrawal. This is not the tariff qualification timer.
entities.time_basis: Original exceeding measurement timestamp, retained in the EV journal. Repeated samples and restart cannot renew it; a clear reading rearms. Cold restart requires strict start evidence.
entities.availability: Editable while HEO is loaded, including during a telemetry outage. Editing never substitutes for fresh evidence.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite whole seconds. Invalid edits are rejected; corrupt saved settings disable retention.
